name: homewizard-cli
description: Tooling entry point for a Python project. The CLI lives in homewizard_cli/; these scripts expose the checks AGENTS.md documents so any tool that asks the repository what to run gets an answer.

scripts.lint: uv run ruff check homewizard_cli/ tests/
scripts.typecheck: uv run python -m mypy --check-untyped-defs homewizard_cli/ tests/
